parameters.query:
WITH filtered_offers AS (
    SELECT
        offer_id,
        external_offer_id,

        chain_id,
        chain_name,

        product_name,
        description,
        extracted_brand,
        extracted_type,
        extracted_category,
        comparison_group,

        price_dkk,
        advertised_before_price_dkk,
        advertised_discount_percent,

        quantity_from,
        quantity_to,
        original_unit,
        normalized_unit,
        comparison_unit_price,

        valid_from,
        valid_until,
        image_url,

        group_chain_count,
        group_offer_count,
        price_rank,
        percent_vs_group_median,

        prior_offer_period_count,
        verified_discount_vs_history_percent,
        historical_price_assessment,
        assessment_confidence,

        display_status,
        status_basis

    FROM v_offer_intelligence

    WHERE (
        $1::text IS NULL
        OR chain_name = $1::text
    )

    AND (
        $2::text IS NULL
        OR extracted_category = $2::text
    )

    AND (
        $3::text IS NULL
        OR display_status = $3::text
    )

    AND (
        $4::text IS NULL
        OR product_name ILIKE
            '%' || $4::text || '%'
        OR COALESCE(description, '') ILIKE
            '%' || $4::text || '%'
        OR COALESCE(extracted_brand, '') ILIKE
            '%' || $4::text || '%'
        OR COALESCE(extracted_type, '') ILIKE
            '%' || $4::text || '%'
    )
),

paged_offers AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered_offers

    ORDER BY
        CASE display_status
            WHEN 'exceptional' THEN 1
            WHEN 'good' THEN 2
            WHEN 'current_cheapest' THEN 3
            WHEN 'normal' THEN 4
            WHEN 'currently_comparable' THEN 5
            WHEN 'expensive' THEN 6
            ELSE 7
        END,

        percent_vs_group_median
            ASC NULLS LAST,

        valid_until ASC,
        product_name ASC

    LIMIT $5::integer
    OFFSET $6::integer
)

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'data',
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT jsonb_agg(
                to_jsonb(paged_offers)
            )
            FROM paged_offers
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ),

    'pagination',
    jsonb_build_object(
        'total',
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM filtered_offers
        ),

        'limit',
        $5::integer,

        'offset',
        $6::integer,

        'hasMore',
        (
            $6::integer + $5::integer
        ) < (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM filtered_offers
        )
    ),

    'filters',
    jsonb_build_object(
        'chain',
        $1::text,

        'category',
        $2::text,

        'status',
        $3::text,

        'search',
        $4::text
    )
) AS response;
